mapper.select:
SELECT permission_id AS permissionId, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_nm AS permissionNm, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS permissionDc, CASE WHEN permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, use_at AS useAt, created_at AS frstRegistPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS frstRegisterId, created_at AS lastUpdtPnttm, 'SYSTEM' AS lastUpdusrId FROM tb_permission WHERE use_at = 'Y'
AND permission_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionNm}, '%')
AND ( (#{permissionLevel} = 'write' AND permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE') OR (#{permissionLevel} = 'read' AND permission_code = 'PERM_READ') )
ORDER BY permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_permission ( tenant_id, permission_code, permission_nm, use_at, created_at ) VALUES ( (SELECT TOP 1 tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = 'PLATFORM' ORDER BY tenant_id), #{permissionCode}, #{permissionNm}, #{useAt}, GETDATE() )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'write' WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_READ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'read' ELSE 'none' END AS permissionLevel FROM tb_role_menu_permission rmp INNER JOIN tb_menu m ON rmp.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_role r ON rmp.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND m.menu_url = #{menuUrl} AND m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y'
